_note: Corporate actions that break raw bhavcopy price continuity (splits, bonuses). Read by src/ingestion/corporate_actions.py, applied to HISTORICAL bars only — the bar on/after ex_date is never scaled, so live marks and execution prices stay raw.

_schema.ex_date: YYYY-MM-DD — the first session at the NEW price basis
_schema.ratio: shares AFTER / shares BEFORE. 1:5 split -> 5. 1:1 bonus -> 2. 1:2 bonus (1 for every 2 held) -> 1.5
_schema.verified_against_nse_circular: true only when someone checked the NSE corporate-action circular. bhavcopy_gap = the exchange's own price/volume discontinuity was measured in data/lake/bhavcopy, which is evidence of the ratio but not of the classification

_how_to_fill: python3 -m src.ingestion.corporate_actions --scan SYMBOL [--days 3000] lists candidate ex-dates from the lake's own gaps; confirm the ratio (NSE circular or the yfinance cross-check: --yf-check SYMBOL EX_DATE, MAC-ONLY) and paste the row into `actions`. Never invent a ratio; a wrong factor is worse than a raw cliff because it is invisible.
